original.statement: flux 2.7.0 adds read-only commands for the ArtifactGenerator kind to the flux CLI.

decision.reason: [ev-707cfb9a39bd] is the only evidence. It is a single CLI changelog line saying that read-only commands for the ArtifactGenerator kind were added in 2.7.0. It describes a purely additive capability and names no configuration, API group/version or setting that would narrow which environments get it. So the only defensible exposure is every environment upgrading from before 2.7.0, which is what edge-from-version in-range <2.7.0 says. Narrowing it to ArtifactGenerator usage would need a group and version that this evidence does not provide.
